authority: This file owns archive URL, bytes, SHA256 and retention metadata; tools/evidence_inventory.json references archive below without copying them.

archive.retention_policy: Keep the versioned public asset retrievable while this PR or repository references it; updates publish a new asset version, never replace these bytes.

availability.public_archive: All 56 files published at dec7a734, byte-for-byte; no new redactions. Original private artifacts were never part of that snapshot.
not_in_public_archive: Complete original trace payloads and private launch/server logs
Generated WAVs, model/evaluator weights and TensorRT engine caches
Raw rows for the three excluded early screens and summary-only diagnostic/interrupted cells
availability.restricted_retention: Original host captures remain controlled by the evidence owner; no public URL or replay guarantee is claimed for them. Their digests identify external inputs and are not proof of availability.

verification_contract.format: Offline inventory validates archive digest/size schema only; it does not fetch assets or certify availability.
verification_contract.explicit: verify_archive.py --download checks availability, bytes/hash before bounded extraction, all original file hashes, complete retained trial coverage, metric summaries and the preserved CPU checker.
verification_contract.comparison: Structure, IDs and integers exact; finite numerical results use absolute tolerance 1e-12, no relative tolerance.
verification_contract.failure: Each failure identifies metadata, download, archive_bytes, extraction, snapshot_integrity or recomputation; historical verdicts remain unchanged.
